beats.html:
Robert Burns explained
Halloween fortune telling
in 16 footnotes.

His poem Halloween
was published in 1786.

Pulling kail stalks eyes shut.
An apple before a mirror
by candlelight.
He wrote the rituals down
so they would not be lost.

beats.html:
Halloween's autumn town
was filmed in a
Los Angeles spring.

Haddonfield was built
from Los Angeles locations
in spring 1978.

With about $300,000,
they could not travel
to find real autumn.
The fall you remember
was made in sunshine.

beats.html:
Your goosebumps are built
for fur you no longer have.

Thick fur traps warmth.
Humans barely benefit.

In mice, the same cells
help regrow hair.
A leftover reflex
that still has work to do.

beats.html:
In 1999, theaters handed out
missing person flyers.

Filmmakers asked viewers
for information about
the 3 students.

Those materials are now held
by a university library.
The scare began
before the lights went down.

beats.html:
A bonfire was once,
quite literally, a bone fire.

In the late 1300s it was
bonfir or banefire.

A fire for burning bones.
Forgotten by the 1700s.
The word began
as bone plus fire.

beats.html:
The first Treehouse of Horror
ended with Edgar Allan Poe.

October 25, 1990.
An earnest telling
of The Raven.

James Earl Jones narrated.
Bart was the bird.
A cartoon gave kids
their first Poe.
